```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

non_bolted_counts <- read.table("/students/2026-2027/Thema05/plantanalysegroep2/Mapping_Non_Bolted/counts_output.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", skip = 1, row.names = 1)
bolted_counts <- read.table("/students/2026-2027/Thema05/plantanalysegroep2/Mapping_Bolted/counts_output.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", skip = 1, row.names = 1)

cleaned_non_bolted <- non_bolted_counts[, c(names(non_bolted_counts)[-(1:5)])]
names(cleaned_non_bolted) <- paste0("None_r", 1:ncol(cleaned_non_bolted))

cleaned_bolted <- bolted_counts[, c(names(bolted_counts)[-(1:5)])]
names(cleaned_bolted) <- paste0("Bolted_r", 1:ncol(cleaned_bolted))


both_cleaned <- cbind(cleaned_non_bolted, cleaned_bolted)

barplot(colSums(cleaned_bolted) / 1e6, las=2, cex.names=0.7, ylim=c(0,120))
barplot(colSums(cleaned_non_bolted) / 1e6, las=2, cex.names=0.7, ylim= c(0,120))
```



```{r cars}
library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)


(ddsMat <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = both_cleaned,
                                  colData = data.frame(samples = names(both_cleaned)),
                                  design = ~ 1))

rld.dds <- vst(ddsMat)
rld <- assay(rld.dds)


plotPCA(rld.dds, intgroup = "samples")

library(ggplot2)

# Perform PCA
```
